groups.label: Profile
groups.rule: Copied from the customer dimension at customer_key. These five fields are attributes, not behaviour.

groups.label: Engagement
groups.rule: One COUNT per event type over history rows only (event_ts ≤ as_of). A purchase is an event type, not an order-table lookup.

groups.label: Commerce
groups.rule: SUM(value) on purchase and return rows, distinct counts over product, channel and campaign identifiers, mean discount and SUM(qty). All over history rows.

groups.label: Preference
groups.rule: COUNT history rows per product category and per touch channel. These are behavioural histograms, not model outputs.

groups.label: Recency
groups.rule: Days between as_of and the last event / last purchase; ratios over tenure and orders; category entropy over the six category counts.

groups.label: Outcomes
groups.rule: Computed from the first 30 and 90 days after as_of. Churn is 1 when no purchase occurs inside that horizon. The stream keeps these rows too.

reconcile.label: Orders, next 90d
reconcile.from: purchase rows in the 90d after as_of

reconcile.label: Value, next 90d
reconcile.from: Σ value over those purchase rows
